narr: A line of thunderstorms passed across Mercer County during the early morning hours of July 19th, producing anywhere from 1.75 inches to 2.25 inches of rainfall within a hour. Automated rain gages indicated that rainfall rates at times were in excess of 3 inches per hour.
ev: Water flooded the Midway Tunnel on Bramwell Road at least 3 feet deep. One automobile became stranded in the flood waters. The driver was able to evacuate the car. Property damage is the estimated damage to the car.
Grassy Branch was observed flowing out of its banks and across Grassy Branch Road at least 6 inches deep. No damage was reported to the road, and it was open to traffic after the flooding receded.
